title: Atomic results comparison

histogram_key.description: Identity of this exact generation and pair of bin grids; may be sent as known_histogram to omit unchanged bins.

freshness.description: Absolute UTC epoch seconds from the durable server snapshot. expires_at is the next scheduled population-dependent validation, including unchanged-generation validation; a client must not restart it on download. Client reuse is additionally bounded to one hour from receipt. Older servers omit these optional fields and retain the legacy ten-minute client fallback. Personal best, account, car/rules and frame matching are additional reuse requirements.

description: One shared refreshed distribution for both charts, over all available comparable real and artificial drivers. Compatible public/development board entries are deduplicated by driver, choosing each driver's best race and flying lap. Artificial records remain development-gated and isolated from public competitive ranks. Up to 4096 drivers, exact placement replaces the player's frozen entry with the display-only candidate. Larger fields use indexed current personal PBs against the snapshot and set comparison_approximate; their self-correction may differ by at most one place. Snapshot lag can additionally reflect newer accepted results until refresh. Neither path writes records. Default resolution is 16 bins. Display-only candidates may reserve the bin domain before verification without adding samples; minimum/maximum remain actual verified extrema. Optional paired race_from_ticks/race_to_ticks and lap_from_ticks/lap_to_ticks preserve an existing displayed domain on refresh. New genuine extrema outside that domain expand it so no driver is omitted. No opponents means null comparison. Top ten display position; remaining positions show an upward-rounded top-percent threshold.
